summary.tldr: Amends the Criminal Code to define first responders, make their murder first degree murder, raise aggravated assault penalties, and add a specific assault offence.
what_it_does: Creates a Criminal Code definition of first responder, including emergency medical technicians, paramedics, firefighters, and some volunteers.
Makes the murder of a first responder acting in the course of duties automatically first degree murder.
Raises the maximum prison term for aggravated assault to 20 years when the complainant is covered by the first responder rule, instead of 14 years in other cases.
Creates an offence for assaulting a first responder and updates related federal offence lists used for other criminal law rules.
summary.background: The bill adds a definition of first responder to the Criminal Code. It includes a person employed or formally engaged on a volunteer basis to be among the first on the scene of an accident, fire or other emergency.
